title: model-registry: onboard starling-7b v1.2 + perf profiles & changelog automation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Onboard Starling-7B v1.2 into the model registry with structured metadata, versioning, performance profiles, and automated changelog/release note generation. Motivation: Starling-7B is a commonly requested open model with a new v1.2 release that includes attention optimizations and improved tokenization. Customers running latency-sensitive workloads requested an explicit perf profile and quantization recommendations. This PR implements: 1) model metadata entry (model.yaml) with canonical versioning, upstream url, and license; 2) performance profile JSON (perf/starling-7b/v1.2.json) capturing p50/p95 latency, throughput at common batch sizes, and recommended quantization configs; 3) changelog automation hook that extracts model.yaml changes and appends structured release notes to registry CHANGELOG.md on merge; 4) automated release notes template generation for SDK docs; 5) tests and CI changes to validate perf profile schema and changelog formatting. Checklist: - [x] add model metadata and versioned model bundle reference - [x] add perf profile for common GPU families (A10G, A100, T4) - [x] add quantization recommendation matrix (int8/4-bit notes) - [x] implement changelog automation (pre-merge validation + post-merge append) - [x] update registry docs and quickstart examples - [x] unit + integration tests for schema validation Notes on rollout: This PR is additive and non-breaking. The changelog automation is gated behind a feature flag (REGISTRY_CHANGELOG_AUTOMATION) which defaults to off in staging and on in production after a small canary. See Linear ENG-4021 for rollout plan and ENG-4098 for perf profile validation criteria. Related: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4021, internal benchmark artifact link (s3://redwood-perf/starling-7b/v1.2/).
